product_metadata.title: iDesign Recycled Plastic Resipreme Divided Fridge and Freezer, 12” x 4” x 14.5”, Clear
features: DIVIDED FOOD STORAGE ORGANIZER – Keep food separated and clean with the iDesign Freezer and Fridge Organizer Bin; it’s a quick and easy addition to your pantry, cabinet, fridge, or freezer that will bring functional beauty and organized style

INTEGRATED HANDLES – The plastic clear storage bins feature integrated handles that allow for quick access and easy reorganization; built-in feet slightly elevate the bin off of the fridge, freezer, pantry, and cabinet shelves

VERSATILE DESIGN – Maximize your storage space with the versatile freezer food storage container; use in the fridge and freezer to store produce, meat, cheese, drink boxes, food packets, and more; or use it as a pantry organizer to store dry goods

BPA-FREE PLASTIC – Crafted from BPA-free recycled resipreme construction, this clear fridge organizer bin stands up to everyday use; the transparent design allows you to easily view contents at a glance

EFFICIENT SIZE – Whether you use it on its own or with other iDesign kitchen storage organizers, this bin is just the right size to be functional without getting in the way; designed to fit short fridge shelves, it measures 12” x 4” x 14.5”
description: Upgrade your kitchen organization and storage with the iDesign Recycled Plastic Resipreme Divided Fridge and Freezer Bin. It’s a quick and easy addition to your pantry, cabinet, fridge, or freezer that will keep food separated and clean. The versatile bin is ideal for use in the fridge and freezer to store produce, meat, cheese, drink boxes, food packets, and more, or to store dry goods in the pantry and cabinet. Easily access or reorganize your items with the integrated handles. Built-in feet slightly elevate the bin off of the fridge, freezer, pantry, and cabinet shelves. The transparent design of the clear plastic organizer bin ensures items are always visible and accessible. Designed to fit short fridge shelves, it measures 12” x 4” x 14.5”, making it just the right size to store food in your fridge, freezer, pantry, or cabinet. Or use the bin to store kitchen utensils and tools, cleaning supplies, cosmetics, and crafts, or for extra organization in your closet or laundry room. Made from a durable BPA-free clear resipreme construction, this kitchen storage container stands up to everyday use. With iDesign, you can live simply every day.
